text:
marcus.w: Pushed 0.9.7-canary to npm and wheel to PyPI around 18:12 PT. Seeing a small error spike in telemetry for ts SDK. Should we pin the dist-tag and hold the rest of the cohorts?
anya: Can you share the error?
marcus.w: Logs show TypeError in serializer path when options.includeMeta = true. Only in TS clients so far.
sophia.k: thanks — if it's TS-only I'd prefer to pin npm dist-tag to previous tag and leave PyPI alone. That limits blast radius.
eli: Agree. Also set a two-hour quiet window for further publishes while we triage.
marcus.w: deploy-bot: start canary-monitoring (channel devex).
deploy-bot: Canary monitor started for release 0.9.7-canary — metrics: 200rps, error rate +1.3% ↑, latency stable. Alerts: none yet.
anya: marcus, can you run dist-tag pin and add a note in release notes?
marcus.w: doing npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-ts@0.9.6 latest && npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-ts 0.9.7-canary
marcus.w: pinned npm back to 0.9.6; left PyPI untouched. Paste of commands:```bash
# revert npm visible tag
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-ts@0.9.6 latest
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-ts 0.9.7-canary
# if we need to yank package (rare): npm deprecate @redwood/sdk-ts@0.9.7-canary "yanked: use 0.9.6"
```
eli: Good. Add rollback criteria to thread: if error rate >2% sustained for 5m or user-facing exceptions increase, rollback full publish.
sophia.k: For release notes: mark 0.9.7-canary as canary-only and flagged for TS serializer fix; include steps for customers to pin to 0.9.6 if affected.
anya: Ops ask: do we want to cut a hotfix 0.9.7-hotfix-1 or redo canary after fix?
marcus.w: prefer hotfix to minimize confusion in dist-tags: publish 0.9.7-hotfix -> verify canary tests -> then promote. I can prepare branch.
eli: Timeline: triage + patch in 45m, tests 20m, publish hotfix 10m, monitoring 15m. If anything looks bad, revert dist-tag and post a deprecation callout.
sophia.k: Also add instruction in release notes to clients for pinned install examples:
```bash
# TS/JS install pinned
npm install @redwood/sdk-ts@0.9.6
# PyPI stays the same unless you opt in
pip install redwood-sdk==0.9.6
```
deploy-bot: Release note stub created: "0.9.7-canary TS: serializer issue observed; pinned latest to 0.9.6. Hotfix planned." (link: https://console.internal/releases/1746667777)
marcus.w: tagging the thread with #release-window-evening and notifying support to prepare canned responses.
anya: If we need to yank artifact entirely, ops prefers using deprecate + dist-tag removal instead of npm unpublish.
eli: +1. Unpublishing is messy. Deprecate message should include replacement.
sophia.k: I'll draft the final release note blurb and deprecation paragraph, then we can promote once CI green.
marcus.w: OK will update here when hotfix build is ready. For now, hold other publishes and no direct pushes to npm for TS package for next 2 hours.
anya: Thanks — ping me if rollback criteria hit.
marcus.w: Thanks team.
